# Intel XeSS API headers

Unmodified public headers from [intel/xess](https://github.com/intel/xess/tree/de0fb9c1c510661c571164e1418ceca8101dab69), commit `de0fb9c1c510661c571164e1418ceca8101dab69`. Each header declares SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT and preserves Intel's copyright notice.

The SDK's accompanying [license](LICENSE.txt) is retained. No SDK runtime binary is redistributed here. To enable XeSS, obtain `libxess.dll` and its required dependencies from the official SDK and place them beside the game. The addon loads its API dynamically; no import library is needed to compile. Runtime terms apply separately to binaries.
